Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute charges on {agreement}. The agreement covers {contracted_seats} seats, but our invoices have billed us for {billed_seats} seats, which is {extra_seats} seats more than the commitment. The seat price is {price_per_seat}.

The agreement states: "{increase_requires}" No such signed order form exists for the additional seats, so the seats above {contracted_seats} are not authorized under the agreement.

We have been overcharged {overcharged_to_date} to date for the following invoice: {invoices}. The overcharge continues at {overcharge_monthly} per month, or {annualized} per year, until the billing is corrected.

We ask that you issue a credit for the overcharged amount of {overcharged_to_date}, and that future invoices under {agreement} bill only for the {contracted_seats} contracted seats. Please confirm in writing once the credit has been applied and the corrected bill has been issued.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
{sender}
